req.title: Login form GET
req.statement: The system shall serve a login form at GET /auth/login.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /auth/login must return an HTTP 2xx response with a login form. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — normal GET returns 200 with form fields present; (2) negative NEG — wrong HTTP method (POST with no data) still serves the form but we also verify a non-existent path returns 404; (3) boundary BVA — verify the exact status code 200 (not 199, not 201) and that key HTML landmarks exist in the response body to catch constant/string mutations. Each test is self-contained with its own app instance and temp DB.

tests.name: test_login_get_returns_200_with_form
preconditions: Flask app is created in TESTING mode with a temporary database
expected: Response body contains the username input field
Response body contains the password input field
Response body contains a submit/login button or form action
trace: R-FLASKR-007: system shall serve a login form at GET /auth/login
Expected outcome: HTTP 2xx response with expected payload
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import init_db
    init_db()
client = app.test_client()

def test_login_get_returns_200_with_form():
    r = client.get('/auth/login')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert b'name="username"' in r.data
    assert b'name="password"' in r.data
    assert b'<form' in r.data

test_login_get_returns_200_with_form()

tests.name: test_login_get_exact_status_boundary
preconditions: Flask app is created in TESTING mode with a temporary database
actions: Assert status code is exactly 200 (not 199, not 201, not 302)
expected: Response body does NOT contain a server error indicator
trace: R-FLASKR-007: HTTP 2xx response — BVA pins the exact value 200 to catch off-by-one and redirect mutations

import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import init_db
    init_db()
client = app.test_client()

def test_login_get_exact_status_boundary():
    r = client.get('/auth/login')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.status_code != 302
    assert r.status_code != 404
    assert r.status_code != 500
    assert 'text/html' in r.content_type
    assert len(r.data) > 0
    assert b'Internal Server Error' not in r.data
    assert b'Log In' in r.data or b'login' in r.data.lower()

test_login_get_exact_status_boundary()

preconditions: Flask app is created in TESTING mode with a temporary database
actions: Inspect HTML for form method and action attributes
expected: Response body contains a form with method post (case-insensitive)
Response body contains input for username

import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import init_db
    init_db()
client = app.test_client()

def test_login_get_form_action_and_method():
    r = client.get('/auth/login')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.data.lower()
    assert b'method="post"' in body or b"method='post'" in body
    assert b'name="username"' in r.data
    assert b'name="password"' in r.data
    assert b'type="submit"' in body or b'<button' in body

test_login_get_form_action_and_method()

tests.name: test_login_get_unauthenticated_no_redirect
preconditions: Flask app is created in TESTING mode with a temporary database
Client has no session cookie (unauthenticated state)
actions: Send GET /auth/login without any session cookie
Verify no redirect occurs (login page is public)
expected: HTTP status code is exactly 200 (not 302 redirect)
Location header is absent or empty
Response body contains the login form
trace: R-FLASKR-007: login form must be accessible without authentication
STC: unauthenticated state -> login page served directly, no redirect loop
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import init_db
    init_db()
client = app.test_client()

def test_login_get_unauthenticated_no_redirect():
    r = client.get('/auth/login', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.headers.get('Location') is None
    assert b'name="username"' in r.data
    assert b'name="password"' in r.data

test_login_get_unauthenticated_no_redirect()
